checks.name: All generated case-file pages fit phone and tablet widths
Bulletin loops, pauses persistently, and reduced motion shows its full text
Reading controls derive all sections, retain type size and track progress
Evidence images open in a full screen viewer and restore focus
Search uses the feed safely and handles unavailable indexing
Sharing falls back to selectable links when clipboard is unavailable
A newly generated post inherits section controls and contains wide evidence
Desktop retains its layout and the core site works without JavaScript

limits: Physical Firefox/WebKit, native share sheets and hardware keyboards require device checks.
